name: The Source at Sula
why_special: Sula's own 32-room luxury wing inside the working vineyard — vine-view rooms, on-property tasting rooms and 1-2-1 wine experiences with the winemaking team. The destination property for Nashik wine tourism; rates spike sharply during SulaFest in February.

name: Beyond by Sula
why_special: Sula's value-tier sister to The Source — comfort rooms with vineyard outlooks at roughly 40% less. Same Sula tasting access, same vine-walk before breakfast, smaller pool. The wine-country pick when you want vineyard access without Source pricing.

name: Regenta Resort Soma Vine Village
why_special: Royal Orchid's Regenta resort attached to Soma Vineyards — 4 outdoor pools, full-service spa, walk-the-vines on the property's own working winery. 10-min drive from Sula. The destination pool/spa resort for wine tourism that isn't trying to be Sula.

name: Express Inn Nashik
why_special: Central Nashik 5-star on the Mumbai-Agra highway, 10 km from Sula — full business facilities, rooftop pool, multi-cuisine dining. Best for Trimbakeshwar pilgrims and visitors combining wine tourism with Panchavati ghats and Kalaram temple.

name: ibis Nashik Hotel
why_special: Accor-brand ibis 5 km from Sula — modern eco-certified rooms, the most reliable mid-tier brand in Nashik. Use as a base, day-trip to Sula via hotel cab (20 min). Sister property ibis Styles next door for slightly higher tier.
